patterns.note: Content sections alternate between full-width background colors and content-constrained sections with generous horizontal padding.
Main headings use a large, bold sans-serif font, while subheadings and body text use a lighter weight of the same sans-serif, creating a clear typographic hierarchy.
A soft lavender (#F0F0F8) is used as a secondary background color, providing a gentle contrast to the dominant white and dark purple (#2C2C54) palette.
The navigation bar transforms from transparent over the hero to an opaque white background with a subtle shadow and reduced height as the user scrolls down.
The hero background image exhibits a subtle parallax effect, moving slower than the foreground content as the user scrolls.
Content sections and individual cards (e.g., service cards, testimonial cards) animate into view with a subtle fade-up effect as they enter the viewport.
Testimonial sections feature a grid of three cards, each with a circular image, name, and title, presented against a light lavender background.

technique_notes: Implement a sticky navigation bar that starts with a transparent background and full height, then transitions to a solid white background, slightly reduced height, and a soft drop shadow once the user scrolls past the initial hero section.
Create a hero section where the background image scrolls at a slower rate than the overlaying text and call-to-action elements, producing a subtle parallax depth effect.

Utilize scroll-triggered CSS keyframe animations, activated by JavaScript's Intersection Observer, to reveal content blocks such as cards and text sections with a gentle fade-in and slight upward translation as they become visible in the user's viewport.

design_tokens.type_scale: oversized bold sans-serif headings (~3-4x body) with clear hierarchy and smaller, lighter sans-serif body text.
design_tokens.radius: subtle (cards, buttons, and input fields have a slight corner curve)
design_tokens.spacing: balanced (comfortable padding around sections and elements, with an airy hero section)

standout: The site's design is distinctive for its sophisticated use of subtle motion, including a transforming sticky navigation and gentle scroll-triggered reveals, which elevate a clean, modern sans-serif aesthetic. The soft lavender accent color provides a unique and calming brand touch, distinguishing it from more generic corporate health sites.
